name: @monstermann/stdlib-syntax-highlight
description: Syntax highlighting with TextMate grammars, tokenized in WebAssembly, each grammar loaded the first time it is used.
author: Michael Ostermann <michaelostermann@me.com>

scripts.bundle: tsdown && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p stdlib-syntax-highlight && cp ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/stdlib_syntax_highlight.wasm dist/highlight.wasm
